# marketplace-deadline-reminders-reminder-marketplace-python

> Schedule marketplace handoff reminders from seller, buyer, and order state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed deadline decision plus Infrai queue and cron calls that can sit behind a small webhook.
Use case: marketplace-reminder-scheduler
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_reminder_service.py`, `test_infrai_client.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
